limits: Only the classical variant. Every other variant this server plays is generated from the same descriptor format and is checked structurally, not against DATC.
The corpus is godip's: DATC v2.4 section 6, plus the regression files godip collected from Diplicity, Droidippy, dipai and real games. A DATC case godip does not ship is not run here.
Each case is one position resolved once. Nothing here exercises the deadline, the seat rules or the order-entry grammar.
